pages.title: The Ender Guardian
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Ruined Citadel: the Ender Guardian's gauntlet of guard and the maelstrom gauntlet, the zweiender and final fractal, enderite, and the void cores, jaws and crystals of its golems and endermapteras.$(br2)$(thing)Ashen Age$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(thing)40 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Warrior.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Ender Guardian$(n)$(br2)Pays 8 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
